name: RECOIL-v2
mechanism: Per-host federated learning model: each bundled host keeps its OWN response-delta model, and learned state is exchanged across hosts ONLY as explicit secret values, never as raw model internals — so one host's fitted noise baseline cannot contaminate another host's oracle, preserving per-host integrity.
what_it_does_previous_couldnt: As the ladder grew (R4/R6/R16), learned deltas could bleed implicitly between hosts, risking a model trained on A biasing reads from B. Federating isolates each host's 3D model; cross-host transfer is exactly the secret-typed values, never model parameters.
fireback: The operator can distort one host (e.g. add jitter) and watch the OTHER host's oracle stay clean — because models don't bleed. Fireback = the operator's interference on a single rung is contained to that rung; the ladder's other legs are provably uninfluenced.
containment: Models live per-host on bundled loopback fixtures; cross-host edges are constrained to secret-typed values carrying the engagement marker; allowlist resolver governs every host model target; no model internals serialize out of scope.
kill_switch: --shared-model resets to a single global model (opt-out of federation); per-host model wipe clears each; the marker gate prevents any un-markered cross-host value transfer.
novelty_angle: The fireback learning loop is federated per-host with principled isolation — only secret-typed values cross boundaries, so the ladder's learning is parallel across hosts, not shared and contaminated. Multi-host autonomy with per-host epistemic hygiene.
